metas.name: Backrooms
metas.description: Clark, an angry architect, chases the source of impossible power failures when a glowing gap opens in his basement, but the yellow maze beyond it threatens his sanity, his friends, and Mary.

metas.name: Pressure
metas.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice--launch the most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

metas.name: Tuner
metas.description: A talented piano tuner who suffers from hyperacusis discovers an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

metas.name: The Breadwinner
metas.description: When a supermom lands a Shark Tank deal, she switches roles with her breadwinner husband, who struggles to adapt as a stay-at-home dad to their three daughters.

metas.name: Propeller One-Way Night Coach
metas.description: Based on Travolta's 1997 book. Follows young aviation enthusiast Jeff and his mother on a cross-country flight to Hollywood that transforms into a life-changing journey filled with unexpected moments.

metas.name: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
metas.description: Once a lone bounty hunter, Mandalorian Din Djarin and his apprentice Grogu embark on an exciting new Star Wars adventure.

metas.name: Ladies First
metas.description: A male chauvinist is transported to a matriarchal society, facing challenges from a formidable female version of himself.

metas.name: Passenger
metas.description: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger won't stop until it claims them both.

metas.name: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
metas.description: Follows Jack Ryan who reunites with CIA operatives to navigate a treacherous web of betrayal against an enemy who knows their every move, facing a past they thought was long put to rest.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: In the Grey
metas.description: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to steal it back--an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and surv...

metas.name: Driver's Ed
metas.description: A group of teens who steal their school's driver's ed car to go on a road trip to help a high school senior track down his college-freshman girlfriend and win her back.

metas.name: The Crash
metas.description: Follows the Mackenzie Shirilla case, a 17-year-old who intentionally crashed her car into a brick wall in Ohio, killing her boyfriend Dominic Russo and his friend Davion Flanagan.

metas.name: The Christophers
metas.description: The children of a once famous artist hire a forger to complete some unfinished, long ago abandoned canvases so they'll have an inheritance when he dies.

metas.name: The Punisher: One Last Kill
metas.description: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

metas.name: Untold UK: Jamie Vardy
metas.description: Jamie Vardy's evolution from part time football player to a Premier League legend.

metas.name: Marty, Life Is Short
metas.description: Follows the definitive documentary on comedian Martin Short, exploring his career across film, television, theater and comedy.

metas.name: The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

metas.name: Remarkably Bright Creatures
metas.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

metas.name: Mortal Kombat II
metas.description: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

metas.name: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
metas.description: Spanning five decades, Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition charts their iconic rise to become one of the biggest bands in music history.

metas.name: Billie Eilish: Hit Me Hard and Soft
metas.description: An accompanying 3D concert film, documenting the Manchester shows and co-directed by Eilish and James Cameron.

metas.name: Desire
metas.description: Lucero lo tiene todo, pero un vacío la empuja al riesgo. Matías, el atractivo entrenador de natación, despierta en ella una obsesión: una relación que amenaza su mundo cuando su hija también se siente atraída por él.
